title: RobotCursorDemo
content: Interactive Robot Cursor This demo showcases a custom robot cursor that follows your mouse movements and rotates its head to "watch" your cursor as you move around the screen. The robot's head movements are calculated based on the direction and velocity of your cursor. Features Smooth cursor following animation Head rotation based on cursor movement Real-time velocity calculation Responsive design (hidden on mobile) Spring physics for natural movement How It Works Tracks mouse position using event listeners Calculates head rotation based on movement direction Uses Framer Motion for smooth animations Applies spring physics for natural movement Hidden on mobile devices for better UX Try It Out! Move your cursor around the screen to see the robot follow and watch your movements. Notice how the robot's head rotates to follow your cursor direction. Move Here Or Here Try This Technical Implementation The robot cursor is implemented as a React component using Framer Motion for animations. It tracks mouse movements and calculates head rotation based on cursor velocity and direction. Key Technologies: React with TypeScript for component structure Framer Motion for smooth animations and transitions CSS3 for styling and gradients Event listeners for mouse tracking Mathematical calculations for head rotation ); };
